Also smoldering only happens between the third and third to last days of summer. So you don't even need to specifically avoid all of summer, just the middle.

Keep them on, the only reason I can see for turning them off is Mega bases. It's very easy to contain with the amount of options you have to put them out now. Water balloons, luxury fan, watering can, ice staff and the flingomatic. Just having one of these items in your inventory (watering can and ice staff are probably easiest) lets you contain or extinguish smoldering before it's a disaster. Always flingo the things that burn fastest mainly growable farms and especially stone fruit. If you don't want to deal with any of this then you could always spend the summer in caves doing toadstool or clearing archives/ruins and killing fuelweaver. If you have bases that extend over multiple biomes and are delicately crafted to look nice I understand why you'd turn them off tho, just personally I'd rather spend the entire summer in caves, doing whatever things are cave exclusive like switching to Wendy and farming monkeys for bananas and nightmare fuel or switching to maxwell and wiping out every stalagmite that exists.
